notes: Source: 'Chiefs Individual Records' pp. 750-765 of the 2026 media guide (table of contents p2 lists Records 750). Passing/rushing/receiving/defense are on pp. 753-760 and 764-765.

through_season 2025: the guide is the 2026 media guide (IA date 2026-08-12) and its lists carry 2025 seasons (Travis Kelce 2013-25, Chris Jones 2016-25, Patrick Mahomes 2017-25, Mahomes 2025 rows on p755).

p765 footnote: 'These individual records relate solely to service with the Chiefs. They include National Football League regular-season statistics only - with the exception of those single-game records marked by * or **.' In the lists used here '*' marks an NFL record (e.g. *7.0 Derrick Thomas sacks, *4 interceptions); every game dated in these lists is a regular-season game.

The guide prints NO rank numbers on these lists. rank = standard competition rank from the printed order and equal printed values; tie=true on every row that shares its printed value with another printed row.

Game-list dates are converted to M/D/YYYY in years; the printed opponent and date are kept in raw. Three TD-pass rows are printed as 'N times' with the last game dated (Mahomes 6 TD x2, Dawson 5 TD x2, Mahomes 5 TD x4): the date is the last of those games (fields times/note on those rows).
Lists transcribed to the top 5 or 6 rows (all rows when the printed list is short); complete_to is the number of rows the guide prints for that list. Ties at the cut are kept whole.
Names are as printed (e.g. Stephone Paige, Bobby Ply, Mike Maslowski). Art Still's career sack row is printed '1978-87 (Pre-1982)'; Mike Bell's years '1979-85, '87-91'.

Guide-internal disagreement for career tackles: the Superlatives section p816 (Tackles, 'all players with 500 tackles') prints a DIFFERENT list: 1 Derrick Johnson (2005-17) 1,262; 2 Art Still (1978-89) 1,992 [sic]; 3 Gary Spani (1978-86) 999; 4 Derrick Johnson (2005-18) 934 [duplicate name]; 5 Deron Cherry 927; 6 Donnie Edwards 883 (vs 876 on p765); 7 Kevin Ross 827. The p765 Individual Records list was used. Treat Still/Edwards/Spani order as guide-conflicted.

Not used: p758 'Times Sacked' (a quarterback-sacked list, offense), 'Most Passes Had Intercepted' (thrown), the Superlatives career tables (pp. 813-816) and all postseason / opponent / team-record sections (pp. 766-795, 820-823).
